requirements: One position per symbol across strategies and reservation before submission
Predeclared conflict/ranking rules; raw scores are not assumed comparable
Compare isolated and combined AFTER common costs; no forced 50/50 split

limitations: These are dependent alternatives on the same inspected development data. Repeated reference rows are removed, never pooled as independent evidence.
Metrics and hashes establish internal identity/coherence, not independently authenticated market data or correctness of every simulated fill.
Improved losses, positive before-fee P&L or zero operations are not eligible net edge. No best-loser promotion or automatic selection even for synthetic passes.
Combination may alter trades, costs and risk. No combined profit, diversification benefit or correlation estimate is invented from isolated P&L sums.
Candidate eligibility is a development prerequisite; stability, independent frozen validation and operational capital/execution review remain required.
Frozen historical price/rules and assumed costs, empty wallet, fixed lot and shared exposure limits. A feasible row is not a signal, allocation or live funding recommendation.

The collector hardcodes minimumNotionalUsdt=0; it captures minSz/lotSz but does not verify a current minimum order value or all execution rules. Reported feasibility is conditional, not exchange-confirmed.
Budget scenarios are illustrative USDT amounts, not converted BRL or the user's balance. The intended capital in the plan lacks confirmed spendable USDT and current rules.
Capacity checks cash, exposure and recorded minimums only; it does not assert a valid signal, liquid membership, execution liquidity, regional eligibility or complete live risk admission.

Reference risk sizing is disabled: this assessment does not silently enable dormant risk/symbol caps or reduce the configured fixed lot to fit capital. Slippage gaps can exceed initial-stop estimates.
No funding, order, automatic 50/50 split, budget increase, portfolio simulation or promotion is performed. Shared-wallet strategy budgets remain conditional on eligible candidates.
